title: questlog glossary.json
description: OPTIONAL per-project jargon glossary. Each term carries a one-sentence plain meaning the UI shows on hover/tap wherever the term appears. Absent file = no underlines; lint prints a warning and passes. Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.1.

id.description: Lowercase id, prefix by type. Unique within its file.
REQUIRED. Prefix "term-", unique within this file.

term.description: REQUIRED non-empty. Canonical surface form as it appears in text (e.g. "CF Access").

aliases.description: OPTIONAL, default []. Additional surface forms. Array of non-empty strings.

plain.description: REQUIRED non-empty. ONE plain sentence, human register, no other undefined jargon (dogfood: this field is itself jargon-lint-scanned).

note.description: OPTIONAL string, default "". Longer context, shown in the expanded tooltip. Also jargon-lint-scanned.

link.description: OPTIONAL string|null, default null. URL or repo-relative doc path.
